title: scripts/rebuild-local.sh recreates tracy-dsh on the tag it just built (not deploy/.env DSH_IMAGE_TAG=dev), and --ref origin/<branch> builds a branch the clone's refspec does not fetch
steps: S1: Run scripts/rebuild-local.sh --here dsh with APP_IMAGE_TAG=local-develop-eeac5aef against a throwaway repo whose deploy/.env pins DSH_IMAGE_TAG=dev, docker stubbed on PATH; read the environment of the compose up for tracy-dsh.
S2: Run --here web host with APP_IMAGE_TAG unset; read the environment of both compose up calls.
S3: Run --ref origin/wo/research-again host where remote.origin.fetch lists develop only.
expect: S1: exit 0; compose up tracy-dsh gets DSH_IMAGE_TAG=local-develop-eeac5aef and DSH_IMAGE=tracy/dsh.
S2: exit 0; both compose up calls get APP_IMAGE_TAG=dev, WEB_IMAGE=tracy/web, HOST_IMAGE=tracy/host.
S3: exit 0; stdout names the branch head commit it checked out.
S4: non-zero exit, stderr names --ref no-such-ref, no docker build ran.
evidence: 24/10/2026 Mac Studio stand: tracy/dsh:local-develop-eeac5aef built, container tracy-dsh ran tracy/dsh:dev; --ref origin/wo/research-again failed with fatal: invalid reference
fence: Image references and the git ref rebuild-local.sh hands to docker compose and git worktree; no stand, no real docker

tests: compose recreates tracy-dsh on the tag the script just built
compose recreates web and host on the tag just built
--ref that names no commit stops before building anything
